  Mox Emerald {0} — {T}: Add {G}.
  Mox Jet {0} — {T}: Add {B}.
  Mox Pearl {0} — {T}: Add {W}.
  Mox Sapphire {0} — {T}: Add {U}.

• Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand.

{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a token: Draw a card.

Empower Jace 8. (Put eight loyalty counters on a Jace token you control. If you don't control one, first create a blue Jace planeswalker token with "[-1]: Surveil 1" and "[-3]: Draw a card.")

Activated abilities of sources with the chosen name can't be activated unless they're mana abilities.

{6}{W}{W}: Put each card exiled with this artifact into its owner's graveyard, then create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token for each card put into a graveyard this way. Sacrifice this artifact.

{T}: Add {W} or {U}.

Whenever Restless Anchorage attacks, create a Map token.
